title: Repeated refunds create wallet credit
expected: Only paid orders may be refunded once. Rule: app/README.md.
observed: Second refund returned 200; independently read balance increased from 10000 to 11000.
reproduction: Create one book order, pay, refund, repeat refund, read wallet and order.
uncertainty: Local synthetic fixture only; no production exploitability claim.
impact: Extra synthetic wallet credit; unbounded replay follows from code, but only one replay tested.
remediation: Require paid state before refund. Applied in app/app.py and successfully retested.
